info.name: CosQuest Backend API
info.description: CosQuest API. Run Signup (me), save its token automatically, then complete onboarding. The same token enters the app without another login. Community, Spotlight, and Settings additions are in their own folder; see COMMUNITY_SETTINGS_API.md for bodies and behavior. Media fields require choosing a local file.

request.description: Creates the account and signs in immediately. Save token and use it through onboarding. Resume requires the existing password; completed accounts return 409.

item.name: Signup (buddy - a second account for follow/DM testing)

request.description: A second account so Follow/DM/Like-from-another-user requests below have someone to target.

Succeeds with any correct password, even mid-onboarding - check the response’s onboardingRequired to see whether to continue onboarding or use the main app (requireCompletedOnboarding still blocks every real feature until it’s actually finished). On success, automatically saves {{accessToken}} - every other request in this collection inherits it via collection-level Bearer auth, so you never paste a token manually.

exec: pm.test('login failed - did you run Signup (me) + Complete onboarding (me) first?', () => pm.expect.fail(pm.response.text()));

request.description: Invalidates every token issued for this account. Run Login again afterward to keep testing.
Not runnable from Postman - this redirects a real browser to Google’s consent screen. Kept here for reference only.
Not runnable from Postman - this redirects a real browser to Apple’s consent screen. Kept here for reference only.

The one field in this whole collection that can’t be a real literal value: oauthCode only exists after a real Google/Apple redirect completes. Paste a real one into the {{oauthCode}} collection variable if you have one - otherwise this request is for reference only.

Each faction includes a static description/perks list plus live memberCount (onboarded accounts currently in that faction) and activeQuestCount (published live/upcoming quests tagged to it - a label only, never a registration restriction; genuinely 0 until a real quest is tagged, since there’s no quest-creation API yet).
A small preview page of that faction’s onboarded members, e.g. the avatar row on a faction card. 404 for an invalid key.

item.name: Upload avatar photo (multipart, attach a file manually)

request.description: Attach a real JPEG/PNG/WEBP/GIF under the "photo" field before sending. Coexists with Set preset avatar - the real profile UI shows this photo as the main picture with the preset avatar as a small badge over it; setting one never clears the other. The server also tolerates a mislabeled Content-Type on that file (image/jpg, application/octet-stream, text/plain all pass through) since Cloudinary’s real content check is the actual gatekeeper.

Any subset of notificationsEnabled (master switch), eventReminders (a push category), and emailWeeklyNewsletter works in one call - at least one field is required. The category fields are preference storage only; no email sends yet.

CosQuest is played in the real world, so this is required before onboarding can complete - not optional like notifications. radiusMiles must be 5-100; lat/lng are required whenever locationEnabled is true.

Contact holds more sensitive PII (phone, business address) than the other onboarding-step fields above, so unlike those (bare email/username), this pre-login path also requires the account’s real password - wrong identifier or wrong password both return a generic 401.

A GET has no body, so the pre-login identifier+password goes in a standard HTTP Basic Auth header instead of a JSON field - Postman fills this in for you from the Authorization tab (already set to Basic Auth with the literal ME_EMAIL/ME_PASSWORD values). This keeps the password out of the URL, where it would otherwise leak into browser history and server logs.
Submits every required onboarding field at once, including location - all required. Use the token captured at signup. It becomes usable for the main app immediately after completion.
Onboards the second test account used by Follow/DM requests below.

This one also works pre-login (before Complete onboarding / Login) with identifier+password instead of a Bearer token - see "Save contact options (pre-login)" in the Onboarding folder. GET works pre-login too, via HTTP Basic Auth instead - see "Get contact options (pre-login, Basic auth)" there.
Any subset of the three fields works in one call. profileVisibility: public | friends | private. "Friends" = mutual follow (no separate friend-request system exists).
search (optional) matches case-insensitively against the follower’s username, first name, or last name.
search (optional), same matching rules as followers.

Username/first/last name, case-insensitive. Not gated by profileVisibility - it’s for finding someone to message, not viewing their profile - but a block hides them from this in both directions. Feeds the DM "+" picker and the "forward to a new person" flow (POST .../forward with targetUsername instead of targetConversationId).
Also removes any existing follow between the two of you, in either direction. A block hides the profile (404) and blocks new follows/DMs in both directions, overriding any visibility setting.
Returns { url, title, text } ready to hand to a native share sheet (Share.share() on mobile, navigator.share() on web) - the frontend never has to build the link itself.

The actual link to paste into Instagram/Facebook/WhatsApp/etc - real HTML with Open Graph tags, not JSON, so it shows a rich preview card. Open this URL directly in a browser to see the rendered page (Postman will just show the raw HTML here).

item.name: Create an image post (multipart, attach files manually)

request.description: Attach 1-8 JPEG/PNG/WEBP/GIF files under "media" (add more "media" rows for more images) before sending.

item.name: Create a reel (multipart, attach a video manually)

request.description: Attach exactly one real MP4/MOV/WEBM file, 30 seconds or shorter, under "media" before sending. A real Cloudinary account rejects placeholder/fake video bytes as an invalid file - this needs a genuine short video.
Top-level comments only (omit parentComment). Each one includes replyCount.

parentComment must reference a top-level comment - replying to a reply is 400 (replies stay within the original thread). The emoji "reactions" shown under comments in some mockups are frontend-only quick replies, not a real endpoint.
Deleting a top-level comment cascades to delete its replies too.
Auto-captures {{communityConversationId}} and {{factionConversationId}} for the requests below.
404 if either of you has blocked the other; 403 if buddy has turned off allowDirectMessages in their privacy settings.

item.name: Send an image/voice note (multipart, attach a file manually)

request.description: Attach a real JPEG/PNG/WEBP/GIF for an image message, or a real MP3/M4A/WEBM/OGG/WAV for a voice note. A real Cloudinary account rejects placeholder/fake bytes.

item.name: Delete my message - for me only
Delete my message - for everyone (within 5 min)
See who has read a message

request.description: Who has read up to (and including) this message, excluding the sender - naturally 0-1 people in a DM, potentially many in Community/faction rooms. Long-press "Copy text" is frontend-only (clipboard copy of the already-loaded content) and Stories aren’t implemented yet - neither has an endpoint here.

item.name: Forward a message to my DM with buddy

request.description: targetConversationId must be a conversation you already belong to (Community, your faction room, or a DM you’re in) - anywhere else is 403, same as posting there directly. Copies content/media into a new message flagged forwarded: true; the original is untouched. Exactly one of targetConversationId or targetUsername is required - see the next request for the other form.

item.name: Forward a message to a new person by name

request.description: targetUsername works even with no prior DM - finds it via Search people, or creates one on the spot (same as tapping "+" then forwarding), subject to the same block/allowDirectMessages rules as Start/find a DM. Sending both targetConversationId and targetUsername, or neither, is 400.
faction is optional - filters to quests tagged with that faction (a label only, never a registration restriction).

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const quests = pm.response.json().quests || []; if (quests.length) pm.collectionVariables.set('questId', quests[0].id); }

item.name: Attachments, timed pins and bulk actions
item.description: See CHAT_ATTACHMENTS_API.md. Set both messageId and secondMessageId from messages in this source conversation. Bulk endpoints return per-item status; inspect HTTP 207 results. Select files manually for upload requests.
